propositions: Four token-identical or AST-identical helper functions (_shadow, _ticket_id, _positive_int) exist across multiple modules and must be consolidated into single canonical definitions

Three token-identical _shadow implementations in _mcp_writes.py, _mcp_reads.py, _mcp_llm.py and a fourth variant in _lib_ops.py must be unified under src/rebar/_operation_config.py with signature _shadow(surface, repo_root=None)

Three token-identical _positive_int argparse converters in request.py, bridge.py, and reconcile.py must be unified under src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/_common.py, excluding the namesake in _config_resolvers.py which returns a default rather than raising
_ticket_id must move from its twin definitions in steps.py and decide_ops.py to a single canonical location in step_contracts.py
A guard test must verify exactly one definition of each helper exists under src/rebar and that all call sites import from the consolidated module
